scope.summary: Implement the live Pathfinder appearance effects (V,G; non-destructive until expanded, reusing the 14.5 boolean core - NOT a fork): Add/union, Intersect, Exclude, Subtract (front from back), Minus Back (back from front), Divide (independent faces at intersections), Trim (remove hidden filled parts, discard strokes), Merge (trim + merge adjacent same-color faces), Crop (to frontmost outline), Outline/edges (unfilled edge segments), Hard Mix (highest CMYK component), Soft Mix (mixing-rate percentage), Trap (print traps: thickness, tint reduction). Applied as appearance effect on group/layer.
acceptance_criteria: Add, Intersect, Exclude, Subtract, Minus Back, Divide, Trim, Merge, Crop, Outline, Hard Mix, Soft Mix, Trap; reuse 14.5 boolean core
expected_tests: test: live boolean ops reuse 14.5 boolean core (no reimplementation); non-destructive until expand; Trap/Hard Mix/Soft Mix print-composite correctness

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Live pathfinder-as-effect missing; boolean core forked.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
